title: 第23章 爱才如命沈晴岚
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
梁惟石心中不禁一跳，表面却不动声色，模棱两可地回应道：“我们经常在QQ聊天。”

    沈晴岚点了点头，没有再说什么，只是看向梁惟石的眼神越发的异样。

    一旁的县委书记若有所思地看着自己的新联络员。

    这一问一答看似寻常，实则一点儿都不普通。

    简单概括其中信息，就是沈部长提到了一个人，从称呼上判断，这个人应该与沈部长关系匪浅，同时，这个人似乎又和梁惟石有着不一般的关系。

    最后透过现象看本质，一句话提炼中心思想，就是梁惟石与沈部长，在私人关系方面，是有交集的！

    嗯，以后对新联络员的态度尽可能温和一点儿。

    毕竟是新人，又年轻，就算犯了什么错，也是情有可原的嘛！

    梁惟石内心则是疑虑丛生，因为无论上一世还是这辈子，他都未听过李清妍提及沈晴岚。

    所以，这两人之间到底是什么关系？

    沈晴岚怎么会知道他与李清妍有联系？

    九点钟，常青市经济高质量发展工作座谈会，在市委会议中心准时召开。

    会议由市委书记赵汉升主持。

    市长杨凤玉、市委副书记钟岳平、市委组织部长沈晴岚、常务副市长黄政达等市委常委领导，以及各县区委书记，经开区管委会主任，市直有关部门、有关金融机构负责人参加了会议。

    会议听取了有关县区、市直有关部门第二、第三产业发展情况和下一步工作计划汇报。

    文曲县县委书记宋启贤被安排第一个发言，他拿着准备好的材料，神情庄重地开口说道：“尊敬的各位领导，各位同事，下面我就文曲县本年度至今各产业发展情况，以及下一步工作计划，做如下汇报……”

    “文曲县在各项产业发展上，始终坚持知难而进，稳中求进的发展理念，力求做到勇进而不冒进，奋进而不激进，渐进而不急进……”

    “在具体落实过程中，一是推动协作布好局，二是执行制度管根本，三是细抓要素强保障，四是落实政策优环境，五是大力招商增后劲……

    宋书记中气十足的声音在会场中回荡，市委书记赵汉升，市长杨凤玉，组织部长沈晴岚等市委常委忍不住暗暗点头。

    这篇发言稿形式之新，词句之精，构思之巧，立意之深，几乎可以作为材料写作的典范。
content_en:
Liang Weishi's heart skipped a beat, but he remained calm on the surface and responded ambiguously: "We often chat on QQ."

    Shen Qinglan nodded and said nothing more, but looked at Liang Weishi with an increasingly strange look.

    The county party secretary on the side looked at his new liaison thoughtfully.

    This question and answer may seem ordinary, but in fact it is anything but ordinary.

    To briefly summarize the information, Minister Shen mentioned a person. Judging from the title, this person should have a close relationship with Minister Shen. At the same time, this person seemed to have an unusual relationship with Liang Weishi.

    Finally, look at the essence through the phenomenon, and extract the central idea in one sentence: Liang Weishi and Minister Shen have an intersection in their personal relationship!

    Well, try to be as gentle as possible towards new liaisons from now on.

    After all, you are a newcomer and you are young, so even if you make any mistakes, they are excusable!

    Liang Weishi was full of doubts in his heart, because he had never heard Li Qingyan mention Shen Qinglan in his previous life or in this life.

    So, what is the relationship between these two people?

    How did Shen Qinglan know that he was connected to Li Qingyan?

    At nine o'clock, Changqing City's high-quality economic development work symposium was held on time at the Municipal Party Committee Conference Center.

    The meeting was chaired by Zhao Hansheng, Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee.

    Mayor Yang Fengyu, Deputy Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee Zhong Yueping, Municipal Party Committee Organization Minister Shen Qinglan, Executive Vice Mayor Huang Zhengda and other Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee leaders, as well as county and district committee secretaries, directors of the Economic Development Zone Management Committee, and heads of relevant municipal departments and relevant financial institutions attended the meeting.

    The meeting heard reports on the development status of the secondary and tertiary industries and the next work plan from relevant departments at the county, district and municipal levels.

    Wenqu County Party Committee Secretary Song Qixian was arranged to be the first to speak. He took the prepared materials and said solemnly: "Dear leaders and colleagues, I will make the following report on the development of various industries in Wenqu County this year so far, as well as the next work plan..."

    "In the development of various industries, Wenqu County has always adhered to the development philosophy of advancing despite difficulties and striving for progress in stability, and strives to advance bravely but not rashly, forge ahead but not radically, and gradually but not make rapid progress..."

    “In the specific implementation process, the first is to promote cooperation and layout, the second is to implement the system to manage the fundamentals, the third is to pay close attention to the elements and strengthen guarantees, the fourth is to implement policies and optimize the environment, and the fifth is to vigorously attract investment to increase stamina...

    Secretary Song's energetic voice echoed in the venue. Municipal Party Committee Secretary Zhao Hansheng, Mayor Yang Fengyu, Organization Minister Shen Qinglan and other Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee members could not help but nod secretly.

    The new form of this speech, the essence of words, the cleverness of conception, and the depth of intention can almost serve as a model for material writing.
title_en: Chapter 23 Love is like fate Shen Qinglan
